speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg; to help me understand your condition, have you noticed any numbness, weakness, or difficulty moving your foot?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Sciatica (likely due to a lumbar disc herniation). Given your age and the sudden onset of sharp pain radiating to the foot after exercise, a disc herniation is the most probable cause. Have you experienced any loss of bowel or bladder control?
